item.title: TNPSC Group 4 Result 2025 Not Yet Announced
item.description: The Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission has not announced the TNPSC Group 4 Result yet. Candidates who took the Group 4 written exam on July 12, can check their results on tnpsc.gov.in when they are out.

item.title: US Clarifies H-1B Fee Rules: Relief for Indian Workers
item.description: The US government has clarified rules about the new H-1B visa fee. Current H-1B holders and students changing to H-1B status will not have to pay the $100,000 fee. This news brings relief to many Indian workers and students in America.

item.title: RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026: Apply Now for 5195 Posts
item.description: The Railway Recruitment Board started taking applications for RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment on October 21, . People who want to apply can do so on the RRB website until November 20, . There are 5195 jobs available in different posts.

item.title: SSC Constable Recruitment 2025: Registration Closes October 21
item.description: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) will end registration for SSC Constable Recruitment on October 21, . Candidates can apply for Constable posts in Delhi Police on ssc.gov.in. The exam will fill 7565 jobs.

item.title: CTET 2025 Notification Not Yet Released by CBSE
item.description: The Central Board of Secondary Education has not released the CTET Notification yet. When it comes out, people who want to take the Central Teacher Eligibility Test can check the official CBSE CTET website at ctet.nic.in.

item.title: Youth Migration in India: Challenges and Opportunities Explored
item.description: Many young people in India are moving from villages to cities for work. This is causing problems in both rural and urban areas. A new report looks at why this is happening and what can be done about it.
